reasons.R1: Wire/protocol/storage identifiers, trusted process arguments and credential-safe diagnostics. Canonical presentation diagnostics are linked to Runtime; external data remains verbatim.
reasons.R2: Canonical diagnostic; localize only at presentation via exact key or the explicit anchored adapter.
reasons.R3: Fixed composed diagnostic uses the audited loginInstructions constant; never interpolates external data.
reasons.R4: Audited localized literal, including dynamic choice/plural/accessibility branch.
reasons.R5: Foundation identifiers, placeholder grammar, resource paths and preferences. Common keys explicitly linked; never translate stored identifiers.
reasons.R6: Canonical English diagnostic sources linked to Runtime; other literals are stable IDs, operations or model/provider data, not presentation keys.
reasons.R7: Verbatim transcript/model/code data, symbols, accessibility identifiers, key equivalents and parsing delimiters; presentation and AX prose are explicitly linked to ChatUI.
reasons.R8: App-owned presentation linked to App/Runtime; other literals are nonsecret storage/fixture/protocol data and stable identifiers. Simulated transcripts stay verbatim.
reasons.R9: Appearance-owned labels/help and explicit dynamic choice keys are linked to Appearance. Other literals are canonical nonsecret preference/table identifiers, never display labels.
